comparison.objective: Seat a screwdriver in a fitted case and close the lid until its clasp catches.
comparison.physical_skill: Precision placement followed by hinge closure and spring-clasp engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Tool seated, lid shut and latched, case stable, arms withdrawn.
comparison.reason: Clasp engagement is a different one-way closure operation; there is no fastener loosening, collar tuning, witness-torque retention test, or repeated response criterion.
